company.name: Center for a New American Security

profile_text.body:
The Center for a New American Security (CNAS) is a nonprofit organization founded in 2007 and headquartered in Washington, DC. Its website describes the organization as developing strong, pragmatic and principled national security and defense policies.

On artificial intelligence, the site notes that AI systems continue to progress at a steady pace, feeding forecasts about artificial general intelligence. It argues that the path forward is to lengthen the United States' AI lead by expanding, not weakening, technology protections, starting with closing three priority gaps, one of which is remote access.

No litigation cases or products are listed for the organization. It has legal exposure in Washington, with 114 associated matters.
